evidence.description: CRIT-103 passThreshold state (b) requires boilerplate fallback in exactly the scenario PROP-19 (verification-architecture.md:41) says must 'never' use the boilerplate template and REQ-4b (behavioral-spec.md:27-28) says must SKIP -- see FIND-001.
REQ-20 (verifier/browser-review role) reviewed and compared against CRIT-101's passThreshold, which never actually tests it -- see FIND-002.

PROP-21's 3-step note_create_rich_draft -> note_set_eyecatch -> note_set_single_price chain reviewed; no CRIT-XXX tests its mid-chain partial-failure edge cases -- see FIND-005. CRIT-102 (contracts/sprint-2.md:13-17) was also reviewed and IS a well-constructed discriminating edge-case criterion for the JP-punctuation boundary (PROP-18) -- no defect found there specifically.

REQ-16's NOTE_SESSION_COOKIE-based verification reviewed against CRIT-104/CRIT-105's evidence-capture requirements (contracts/sprint-2.md:23-32) -- no criterion gates against credential leakage into notify.json/screenshot evidence -- see FIND-006.
CRIT-101 vs CRIT-102/103/104 compared line-by-line: CRIT-101 grades no fact not already graded by the other three -- see FIND-003.
CRIT-105's 'real, cited content' qualifier reviewed against REQ-5(e)'s objective-threshold model -- found non-binary -- see FIND-004.

Sprint-2 scope items (4) and (5) compared against the 'Explicitly OUT of Sprint 2' waiver (lines 76-78) and CRIT-105/CRIT-106 (lines 28-37) -- the real, human-reviewable evidence requirement and the PROP-21 fix are never jointly gated -- see FIND-007.
